name: brdcomp-button
title: Button
description: An interactive control for actions and form submissions. Variants: default (primary), outline (secondary), secondary (tertiary), destructive (error). Sizes: sm, default, lg, icon, icon-sm, icon-lg. For labeled buttons with icons, compose the icon and text as children. Use IconButton for icon-only actions. Ghost and link are deprecated.

examples.title: Button with leading icon
examples.code:
import { Download } from "lucide-react"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

<Button variant="outline">
  <Download className="size-4" />
  Export
</Button>
